patch_description: This uses a deterministic multi-island maximin search rather than returning a fixed lattice. Each island enforces a different plausible boundary structure: the three vertices plus either three or six additional boundary points, with remaining points free in the interior. A vectorized evolutionary active-set search repeatedly mutates, differentially recombines, projects candidates back into the reference triangle, and ranks them using the minimum area plus a decaying reward for the low-area tail. The best arrangement is converted affinely into the requested equilateral triangle.
